refuses-unknown-key.quote: refused/written-id.json: $.parts[1].id: unknown-key: 'id' is not part of the grammar here refused/written-id.json: $.parts[2].id: unknown-key: 'id' is not part of the grammar here
refuses-unknown-key.where: PYTHONPATH=. python3 check-plan.py refused/written-id.json | grep unknown-key; ! PYTHONPATH=. python3 check-plan.py refused/written-id.json >/dev/null

refuses-duplicate-key.quote: refused/two-picks.json: $: duplicate-key: key 'pick' is written twice in one object
refuses-duplicate-key.where: PYTHONPATH=. python3 check-plan.py refused/two-picks.json | grep duplicate-key; ! PYTHONPATH=. python3 check-plan.py refused/two-picks.json >/dev/null

refuses-missing-source.quote: refused/evidence-without-source.json: $.parts[1]: evidence-needs-source: evidence needs a source a person can open
refuses-missing-source.where: PYTHONPATH=. python3 check-plan.py refused/evidence-without-source.json | grep evidence-needs-source; ! PYTHONPATH=. python3 check-plan.py refused/evidence-without-source.json >/dev/null

usage-exit-2.quote: usage: check-plan.py FILE... prints "ok N", or one error per line and exits 1
usage-exit-2.where: out=$(PYTHONPATH=. python3 check-plan.py 2>/dev/null); status=$?; test $status -eq 2 && test -z "$out" && PYTHONPATH=. python3 check-plan.py 2>&1 | grep '^usage:'

unreadable-reported.quote: refused/none.json: $: unreadable: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'refused/none.json' refused: 1 error(s) above; fix them and run again
unreadable-reported.where: out=$(PYTHONPATH=. python3 check-plan.py refused/none.json 2>&1); status=$?; echo "$out"; test $status -eq 1 && echo "$out" | grep -q unreadable && ! echo "$out" | grep -q Traceback

bad-encoding-reported.quote: UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xff in position 0: invalid start byte
bad-encoding-reported.where: out=$(PYTHONPATH=. python3 check-plan.py refused/not-utf8.json 2>&1); status=$?; echo "$out" | tail -1; test $status -eq 1 && ! echo "$out" | grep -q Traceback
bad-encoding-reported.fix: Catch UnicodeDecodeError in errors_of as an unreadable file.

expect-refused-summary.where: PYTHONPATH=. python3 check-plan.py --expect-refused refused/written-id.json | tail -1 | grep -x 'refused 1 of 1'

docstring-form.where: sed -n 2p check-plan.py | grep -q '[.]$' && grep -cE '^(usage: |       )check-plan.py ' check-plan.py | grep -x 2

main-form.where: grep -q '^def main(args):' check-plan.py && tail -1 check-plan.py | grep -F 'sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))'

rule-names-documented.where: ! grep -oE '"[a-z]+(-[a-z]+)+"' tree_plan.py | tr -d '"' | sort -u | while read -r rule; do grep -qF "$rule" grammar.txt || echo "undocumented: $rule"; done | grep undocumented

comments-say-why.fix: Delete the four section-divider comments in tree_plan.py and explain or drop the bare noqa directive in check-plan.py.

items.item: check-plan.py comment: valid-plan fixture is not counted
items.quote: # A *-plan.json is the valid plan an answer fixture is applied to, so it is

items.item: tree_plan.py comment: source a reader can open
items.quote: # A source a reader can open: a link off the writer's machine, or a person and the day they said it, dot-free since the page draws it.
